foreground_lpips.foreground_mask: evaluator identity body/gaze colors plus fixed evidence, official, and pending marker colors, linf tolerance 18, dilation radius 3

goal_marker_accuracy.score: mean exact three-bit presence-vector match on terminal generated frames

identity_stability: expected evaluator appearance body color detected in each generated future frame divided by expected person observations
person_count_accuracy: fraction of generated future frames whose detected appearance count equals evaluator person_count
